description:
A CAD application built with Rust — 2D/3D drawing, DWG/DXF support, and GPU-accelerated rendering.


OpenCADStudio - Release v2026.42 (2026-10-18)
> Summary: Major release introducing native dynamic block authoring and evaluation; new DGN, PDF, and 3D model import workflows; a redesigned docking and Graphic Attributes workspace; broad web/PWA improvements; and extensive drafting, layout, automation, plugin, rendering, and file-compatibility work.
🌟 Notable Release Notes
- Dynamic Block Parameters: Karim Jerbi implemented native Point, Linear, Polar, XY, Rotation, Alignment, Flip, and Visibility parameter authoring and editing, including parameter grips and base-point insertion in the Block Editor. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Dynamic Block Actions & Tables: Added Move, Scale, Rotate, Flip, Stretch, Polar Stretch, and Array action authoring and evaluation, plus Lookup tables, Test Block evaluation, and Block Properties Tables. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Import Workflows: Added IMPORT, DGNIMPORT, PDFIMPORT, and PDFSHXTEXT support, with DGN V7/V8, 3D Studio, SAT/ACIS, STEP, IGES, WMF, PDF geometry, and SHX text recognition. (Contributed by @ramox81, @HakanSeven12, and @sclMAX)
- Workspace & Graphic Attributes: Introduced vertical palette rails, auto-hide flyouts, floating and grouped panels, draggable tabs, and a persistent Graphic Attributes palette. The Graphic Attributes palette was contributed by @MarcelP102.
- Browser & PWA: Added in-place browser saving, offline PWA operation, crash recovery, web plotting, worker-routed file operations, expanded format support, and bounded image decoding. (Contributed by @afonsop)
- Drafting, Views & Layouts: Added -VIEW, DVIEW, MVSETUP, PUBLISH, REFEDIT, TXT2MTXT, ATTMAN, layout viewport creation and copying, and updates to selection, snapping, measurement, and geometry editing. (Contributed by @ramox81, @HakanSeven12, @gianlucafiore, and @turbuczn)
- Automation & Plugin APIs: Expanded MCP preflight, entity schemas, batch bindings, guides, and capture resources; added reference-only entities, plugin entity labels, and control notifications. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi, @YsDirector, and @schoeller)
- 3D Modeling & Exchange: Added associative extrusion/revolution/loft sources, associative arrays, mesh section tools, and FBX export. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
🚀 New Features
Blocks & Definitions
- Block Definition & Write Block: Added command-line and dialog workflows for BLOCK/BMAKE and WBLOCK, with previews, block attributes, and open-in-editor actions. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @KarimJerbi)
- Block Editor: Added a dedicated authoring palette, contextual ribbon, definition Properties, save-as workflow, Test Block preview, and isolated session history with save checkpoints. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi and @HakanSeven12)
- Native Parameters: Added Point, Linear, Polar, XY, Rotation, Alignment, Flip, and Visibility parameter placement and editing, with selection and editing of native parameter grips. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Dynamic Actions: Added Move, Scale, Rotate, Flip, Stretch, Polar Stretch, and Array actions, including independent reference grips, editable action selections, and reference re-evaluation after definition changes. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Visibility States: Added visibility-state authoring and block visibility commands, plus a visibility dropdown for dynamic block references in Properties. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @KarimJerbi)
- Lookup & Block Properties Tables: Added Lookup authoring, row evaluation on block references, reverse input validation, polar angle input, and Block Properties Table authoring from the editor. (Contributed by @KarimJerbi)
- Block Attribute Manager: Added BATTMAN/ATTMAN with staged changes and one undo step per Apply. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- Associative Arrays: Added ARRAYRECT and ARRAYPOLAR, editing from native records, and source editing through ARRAYEDIT. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Block Attribute Synchronization: Added ATTSYNC to rebuild block-reference attributes from their definitions. (Contributed by @ramox81)
References, Import & Export
- Reference Editing: Added REFEDIT, -REFEDIT, and REFSET with nested reference editing, a working-set dialog and toolbar, and write-back to external references. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- External References: Added command-line options and file types for ATTACH, EXTERNALREFERENCES open/close commands, ERSTATE, and ULAYERS. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- DGN Import: Added DGNIMPORT for V7/V8 drawings, cells and shared cells, 3D elements, text, curves, references, and filled shapes. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- Model Import: Added IMPORT support for 3D Studio, SAT/ACIS, STEP, IGES, and WMF, with ACISIN and WMFIN commands. STEP colors and trimmed/bounded IGES surfaces are retained. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- PDF Import & SHX Text: Added PDF import dialog and command-line workflows with viewport measure scale and curve recognition. PDFSHXTEXT recognizes SHX text geometry and converts it to MText. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- SVG Export: Added EXPORTSVG for native vector SVG output. (Contributed by @hvfrancesco)
- 3D Exchange: Added FBXEXPORT for drawing meshes and web-build support for OBJ import and STEP/STL export. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @afonsop)
- Text Conversion & Outlining: Added TXT2MTXT to combine text into MText and TXTEXP to convert text into character outlines. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Paste Formats: Added PASTESPEC to choose the format used for clipboard pasting. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
3D Modeling, Geometry & Drafting
- Associative Surfaces: Added associative extruded, revolved, and lofted surfaces with spline, ellipse, and region-boundary sources. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- Mesh Section Tools: Added mesh SLICE, live section cuts with top/bottom volume grips, and SECTIONCULL to remove geometry outside a section. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Selection Filter (FILTER): Added advanced entity and attribute filtering with normalized logical operators. (Contributed by @turbuczn)
- Measurement Tools: Added radius and angle measurement tools with a dynamic overlay, Quick mode in MEASUREGEOM, and region loop support in AREA. (Contributed by @turbuczn, @HakanSeven12, and @ramox81)
- No-Trim Chamfer & Fillet: Added TRIMMODE=0 support to preserve source geometry during CHAMFER and FILLET. (Contributed by @YsDirector)
- Object Snap Overrides & Tangency: Added transparent object-snap overrides during active commands and line tangency support while constructing arcs. (Contributed by @yztink)
- Selection Gestures: Added drag-to-move and Ctrl-drag-to-copy, Ctrl-click selection of a polyline segment, configurable OSNAP capture radius, and controls for selection highlight opacity and width. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @gianlucafiore)
- Advanced Geometry Editing: Added hatch boundary vertex grip actions, improved STRETCH for arcs and splines, and added COMPARE overlays for differences between drawings. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Views & UCS: Added command-line -VIEW presets, orthographic UCS and window options, DVIEW twist, and custom solid, gradient, and raster view backgrounds. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Layout & Plotting Commands: Added MVSETUP, batch PUBLISH, first-open layout viewports, and layout copying from the tab menu. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @ramox81)
- Plot Output: Added drawing layers to PDF output and retained PDF plotting in web builds with quality presets and an in-page preview. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @afonsop)
- Other Drafting Commands: Added HPASSOC, PGP alias-file import and UCS-follow workflows, plus a setting to control colored grid axes. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @Pictus08)
- Drafting Variables & Input: Added SELECTIONCYCLING, standard TRIM/EXTEND mode with TRIMEXTENDMODE, current-layer transfer with LAYCUR, and typed-angle locking for the next point. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Image & Underlay Adjustment: Added ADJUST, -IMAGEADJUST, and PDF/DWF/DGN underlay adjustment, along with XDWGFADECTL profile persistence. (Contributed by @ramox81)
- Block Rendering Efficiency: Packed block-wire definitions into shared buffers and cached repeated block copies as lightweight wires. (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Key Tips & Selection Feedback: Added Alt-driven key tips for ribbon tabs, controls, and menus, and clearer per-pick selection counts. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @ramox81)
- UCS & Snapping: Added dynamic UCS on planar solid faces, clickable UCS origin setting, configurable OSNAP aperture, and snap marker size control. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @gianlucafiore)
- Dimension & Font Settings: Added standard arrowheads to dimension pickers, font/plot-style folder options, and improvements to dimension text and style handling. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Startup Scripts: Added /b startup script support, matching --script. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
UI, Workspace & Graphics
- Docking Workspace: Added palette groups, vertical icon rails, per-edge auto-hide, flyouts, floating windows, grouped and draggable tabs, adjustable slot heights, and float/dock controls.
- Layer Manager Palette: Integrated LAYERS into the docking workspace with persistent layout behavior.
- Graphic Attributes Palette: Added fill, line, transparency, and lineweight controls, open-boundary handling, varied-value indicators, layer creation, and persistent docking. (Contributed by @MarcelP102)
- Color Selection: Added color-book folders and browsing, RAL Classic and CSS Colors books, document-color search, RGB/CMYK/gradient controls, and an eyedropper.
- Menus & Command Line: Added a classic pull-down menu bar, ribbon toggle, adjustable command-line opacity, and execution of rebound Space from the command line. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12 and @theluckystrike)
